input.sql: select d.PSE_ACT_SNDS, d.PSE_ACT_SNDS_LIB, sum(f.PRS_DEP_MNT) s from ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS f left join ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_PROVIDER_ACTIVITY d on f.PSP_ACT_SNDS=d.PSE_ACT_SNDS where f.FLX_ANN_MOI=202502 group by 1,2 order by 3 desc

input.final_sql: select d.PSE_ACT_SNDS_LIB from ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS f join ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_PROVIDER_ACTIVITY d on f.PSP_ACT_SNDS=d.PSE_ACT_SNDS where f.FLX_ANN_MOI=202502 and d.PSE_ACT_SNDS<>0 group by d.PSE_ACT_SNDS_LIB order by sum(f.PRS_DEP_MNT) desc limit 3
